name: ObservationDetailPanel
intent: Floating detail for one observation ticket — record fields, lifecycle actions, and its comment/audit thread.
when: A violation selected on a map needs its full ticket without leaving the map
A ticket needs commenting and lifecycle actions in a fixed-width surface

chooseOver.because: TaskMonitor is the full list-plus-detail workspace the Safety Manager list view is built from. ObservationDetailPanel is just the detail half, sized to float over another surface.

commonMistakes: Passing the CommentComposer's HTML straight into CommentItem.body — the body renders as a node, not markup, so the tags print literally. Flatten it to text first.
Letting the panel size to its content — it floats over a map, so the width is fixed and the body scrolls instead.
Prepending new comments while the composer is pinned below — the newest entry lands at the far end of the scroll from where it was typed. Append instead, so it appears directly above the composer.

Closing a panel on Escape without deferring to any layer above it — a press meant to dismiss an open dropdown would take the whole panel with it. Skip the handler while a popover is mounted, and skip already-defaultPrevented events.
stubPlan: dataContract: stub — author input fields, slots, rowIdentity
configSchema: stub — enumerate config props from source

lineage.confidence: unset — open/act/comment flow exercised end-to-end in the browser; no held-out eval yet
notes: Record shape mirrors the Safety Manager list view so a violation reads the same from map or list.
